target_duplicate_timestamp_rule: mean all measurement columns at identical stored times; use same aggregation for Clean/noisy
window_rule: nonoverlapping 2*pi integrated electrical angle; Clean-defined identical bounds for target Clean/10dB
preprocessing: extrema center then meanabs>=0.2 divide maxabs else /100; linearly resample full period to 128
loss: unweighted CE; augmentation averages clean/noisy CE
selection: source clean Val Macro-F1 maximum, earliest exact tie
augmentation: full source Train record, per-phase whole-record RMS-calibrated Gaussian noise then identical window/preprocess; fresh noise each epoch
augmentation_gate: all three paired Clean-10dB differences >0 and mean >=5 percentage points; basic training validity must pass
independence: unique raw current waveform family; windows/7 SNR files not independent units
limitations: publisher exact sampling-rate/field dictionary missing, crosscheck supports assumed units
steady-state guard fixed at two cycles, no complete offline reproduction claim
target Dev supports exploratory Gate0 only, no final blind accuracy
Gaussian enhancement distribution not proven to match publisher
